To this day, after several hundred profiles I've seen and plenty of likes, I've swiped to match with maybe two at most. 2) I've noticed I get a strange influx of likes the second the membership expires, as if my profile is being hidden until premium runs out, then forcing me to pay again if I want to see who liked me (see point #1 about how hard it is to find people in swipe). 3) You can only see 2 people who like you per day, which is garbage compared to every other dating app membership. I'd rather spend the money on Hinge, as expensive as it is, since most of the time the stuff you're paying for with Hily is available FOR FREE on Hinge. This is one of the most scam-like dating apps I’ve seen.

It’s literally not worth your time setting it up.

reviews.title: Temporary ban
reviews.text:
So Hily makes you buy packages of the ability to send emails to the profiles you like. I bought a package of 25 emails which means I should then have the right to SEND 25 emails to 25 profiles. As I’m perhaps 10 emails thru I suddenly get temporary banned for 2 hours. The support rep says I am accused of “spamming” which is absurd. I’m sending one email to one person at a time and using the very 25 emails they sold to me. So then they call it “spamming” is actually USE the 25 emails. But the support rep refuses to say what specifically I’m doing wrong and only points me to the communicate guidelines. I don’t want to get permanently banned but I want to use the emails that I paid them for and they refuse to say if I’m just going to get banned using them. 
Separately this app doesn’t have many people in any given city. I cleared my city’s worth of profiles in one sitting and had to start looking much further away. 
Lastly they offer an advanced search function so that you can supposedly fine tune the type of person you’re looking for. Only any time you select anything in advanced search as soon as you apply it the search just reverts to no advanced search selections. It refuses to work anywhere anytime. So you are forced to go thru every profile including ones you know you don’t want to see. Very frustrating to offer a feature and then not allow it to work

I connected with and sent simple hellos to some of these (at least 10???) that look like maybe there’s some compatibility with and received no response from any of them. reviews.title: Everything has to be paid for.
reviews.text:
The free features might be a nice change compared to other apps, but the main aspects and purpose of the app is held behind numerous paywalls.

If someone has messaged me (and has probably paid for the access) why must I also pay to see it? Most people probably wouldn’t pay, so there isn’t next to no chance you’ll get a response from anyone. Then there’s the algorithm. Your likes and the likes you receive, pretty much mean nothing unless you’re willing to pay to reveal the person. I made an account years ago, and to this day, haven’t come across any of the people who have sent likes and been able to match them, without having paid for the premium. 

Honestly, considering how much you can pay for and the way it makes you feel like you have better chances, it’s actually daylight robbery compared to the mainstream apps that we all know. Don’t waste your time or money with this one. You’re better off investing in bumble, hinge or tinder.
